reportDownloadEmail.title: Download and Email Report
reportDownloadEmail.description: Download the latest report and email it to the team
reportDownloadEmail.prompt: Download the latest monthly report and send it to all team members by email. Use the subject "Monthly Report - [current date]".

fileBackup.title: File Backup
fileBackup.description: Copy files from a specified folder to a backup destination
fileBackup.prompt: Search for all document files in the project folder and copy them to the backup folder. Report the number of files backed up when complete.

scheduleMeeting.title: Schedule Meeting
scheduleMeeting.description: Add a meeting to the calendar and notify participants
scheduleMeeting.prompt: Schedule a "Weekly Review Meeting" for Tuesday at 10 AM next week and invite all team members. Include progress check and issue sharing in the agenda.

csvAnalysis.title: CSV Data Analysis
csvAnalysis.description: Read a CSV file and output statistical information
csvAnalysis.prompt: Read the sales_data.csv file and calculate the monthly total, average, maximum, and minimum sales. Output the results in an easy-to-read table format.

jsonTransform.title: JSON Data Transformation
jsonTransform.description: Transform JSON format data to another format
jsonTransform.prompt: Read JSON data retrieved from the API, extract only the required fields, and convert to a new JSON format. Save the converted data to a file.

dataMerge.title: Merge Multiple Data Sources
dataMerge.description: Merge multiple data files into one
dataMerge.prompt: Read the three files data1.csv, data2.csv, and data3.csv, join them by the common key (ID column), and save the merged data as merged_data.csv.

dailyReport.title: Create and Send Daily Report
dailyReport.description: Summarize today's work and send a report
dailyReport.prompt: Review today's work log, create a daily report summarizing completed tasks, tasks in progress, and issues that occurred, and send it to the manager by email.

notificationSummary.title: Aggregate and Summarize Notifications
notificationSummary.description: Combine multiple notifications into one summary
notificationSummary.prompt: Review all notifications from the past 24 hours, classify them by importance, and create a summary in order of priority.

slackUpdate.title: Slack Status Update
slackUpdate.description: Automatically update Slack status based on work status
slackUpdate.prompt: Check your current calendar schedule and update your Slack status to "In a meeting" if in a meeting, or "Focused work" if working.

codeReview.title: Prepare Code Review
codeReview.description: Check changed files and create review materials
codeReview.prompt: List all files changed in Git and create a summary of the changes for each file. Output as a Markdown document for review.

testRun.title: Run Tests and Notify Results
testRun.description: Run the test suite and notify the team of results
testRun.prompt: Run all tests for the project, summarize the test results (number of successes, failures, and failed test names), and notify the #test channel on Slack.

dependencyUpdate.title: Check Dependency Updates
dependencyUpdate.description: Check if there are updates to project dependencies
dependencyUpdate.prompt: Check package.json and list packages that can be updated. Mark security updates as high priority.

webScraping.title: Collect Information from Web Pages
webScraping.description: Extract required information from specified web pages
webScraping.prompt: Access the specified web page and extract the title, URL, and publication date of the latest news articles, and save them in CSV format.

imageResize.title: Batch Resize Images
imageResize.description: Resize images in a folder to a specified size
imageResize.prompt: Resize all image files in the images folder to 800x600 pixels and save them in the resized folder. Keep the original images.

systemHealthCheck.title: System Health Check
systemHealthCheck.prompt: Check CPU usage, memory usage, and disk free space, and send an alert if any exceeds 80%. Also record the results in a log file.
